input.mainProcess: fresh launch; no old hot-update process reused

protocol.source: ordinary main, temporary synthetic profile; no fixture transport
protocol.focus: native and document focus asserted before each region and after every wheel; separate RAF focus sampler
protocol.profiling: CPU profile plus bounded CDP trace in both regions; diagnostic overhead present
protocol.caveat: fresh process short archive path; not the full old welcome/replay history or physical 1920 display; RAF callback intervals are not presentation times
